verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Outlook acting as an MCP client that can register or plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. The Graph API docs describe developer building blocks for mail access. The one community MCP mention (outlook-comm-13) is about an external LLM reaching email through an MCP integration, which is the reverse direction and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
